title: I Just Released My Indie Game on Steam: Horn & Dice
author: Jiggzawyr
selftext:
I’m excited to share that I’ve just released **Horn & Dice**, a dark roguelike inspired by Slavic folklore, on Steam!

**Steam page:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971770/Horn\_\_Dice/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971770/Horn__Dice/)

  
As a solo indie developer, AI tools played a significant role in helping me bring this project to life. I wanted to share how I used them throughout development.

  
I used **Claude Sonnet and Claude Opus** as coding assistants throughout development. They helped me implement gameplay mechanics, work through bugs, and develop features faster. I still guided the development process, made the design decisions, and iterated on the results.

  
Most of the game's visual assets were generated using **Gemini**. However, the generated images weren't always ready to use as-is, so I also spent time editing and refining them in **Adobe Photoshop** to better fit the game's art direction.

  
I used **OpenMusic.ai** to create the game's music, helping establish the dark, atmospheric mood I wanted for the world.

  
For sound effects, I used **ElevenLabs** to bring more atmosphere and feedback to combat and other in-game interactions.

  
*Horn & Dice* is a dice-building roguelike where every die face represents a combat action. You lock faces, reroll strategically, upgrade your dice, and build combinations to defeat creatures from Slavic mythology.

  
Thanks for reading, and feel free to check out the game.
